annotations.title: List HireLocksmiths products for locksmith businesses

description:
For LOCKSMITH BUSINESSES (or a tool acting for one): what HireLocksmiths sells and how to buy it.

    Use when a locksmith asks about getting listed, the verified badge, missed-call textback,
    the AI text/voice receptionist, review automation, a microsite, or "Own Your City"
    exclusive leads. NOT for consumers looking for a locksmith - use search_locksmiths for them.

    Returns the live catalog (name, price, billing: year/month/one_time, description,
    requires, checkout_url) plus signup_url. Prices are read from the live pricing page.
    There is no agent-side checkout: give the business the checkout_url. With a city slug
    (e.g. "phoenix") also returns that city's listing count and whether the exclusive
    Own-Your-City slot is currently open.

    Args:
        city: Optional city slug from the directory (lower-case, hyphenated, e.g. "san-antonio").
name: list_membership_products
